title: If Ever Said
author: Boby Borah
text:
Did occasionally the temple say
Keep away Rahim,
Did the Majid say seldomly
Don`t utter the name of Ram!
Did the soil say once
The tale of not making slave
in mere writing of someone`s name ,
The river never says
The tale that
The flowing water has
No boundary.

Does religion teach selfishness ,
Is Humanity tells about
The story of sadism!

Is the blue mountain
Under the control of Air,
Or is the blue sky dependent
on the high mountain!

The colour of
No-one`s blood is changed
Though devastated in wild fire of violence ,
Can a desert become a sympathetic heart?

Is love become narcissistic ever?
Is the Inwit not the ultimate God!
Six feet of land reminds the reality
Though snatch the whole of the Earth,
The Soul is not the slave of anyone.
